checks.name: raw_vs_loaded_reconciliation
checks.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_calls) - (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call) - (SELECT count(*) FROM rejected_calls)

checks.name: not_null_foreign_keys
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call WHERE date_key IS NULL OR sample_key IS NULL OR gene_key IS NULL OR pipeline_key IS NULL OR variant_type_key IS NULL OR origin_key IS NULL OR significance_key IS NULL

checks.name: unique_call_id
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT call_id) FROM fact_variant_call

checks.name: range_read_depth_qual_af
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call WHERE read_depth NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 OR qual NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 255 OR alt_fraction NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1

checks.name: flag_is_pass_binary
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call WHERE is_pass NOT IN (0,1)

checks.name: dates_in_calendar_2025_2026
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f LEFT JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.date_key IS NULL OR d.year NOT IN (2025, 2026)

checks.name: orphans_fact_variant_call.sample_key
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f LEFT JOIN dim_sample d ON f.sample_key = d.sample_key WHERE d.sample_key IS NULL

checks.name: orphans_fact_variant_call.gene_key
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f LEFT JOIN dim_gene d ON f.gene_key = d.gene_key WHERE d.gene_key IS NULL

checks.name: orphans_fact_variant_call.pipeline_key
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f LEFT JOIN dim_pipeline d ON f.pipeline_key = d.pipeline_key WHERE d.pipeline_key IS NULL

checks.name: orphans_fact_variant_call.variant_type_key
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f LEFT JOIN dim_taxon d ON f.variant_type_key = d.taxon_key WHERE d.taxon_key IS NULL

checks.name: orphans_fact_variant_call.origin_key
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f LEFT JOIN dim_taxon d ON f.origin_key = d.taxon_key WHERE d.taxon_key IS NULL

checks.name: orphans_fact_variant_call.significance_key
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f LEFT JOIN dim_taxon d ON f.significance_key = d.taxon_key WHERE d.taxon_key IS NULL

checks.name: orphans_fact_variant_call.date_key
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.date_key IS NULL

checks.name: orphans_fact_pipeline_day.pipeline_key
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_pipeline_day f LEFT JOIN dim_pipeline d ON f.pipeline_key = d.pipeline_key WHERE d.pipeline_key IS NULL

checks.name: taxon_role_variant_type_under_C022
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_taxon t ON t.taxon_key = f.variant_type_key WHERE t.facet_label <> 'genetic variant' OR NOT t.is_leaf

checks.name: taxon_role_origin_under_C029
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_taxon t ON t.taxon_key = f.origin_key WHERE t.facet_label <> 'Variant by origin'

checks.name: taxon_role_significance_under_C032
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fact_variant_call f JOIN dim_taxon t ON t.taxon_key = f.significance_key WHERE t.facet_label <> 'Variant by clinical significance'

checks.name: scd2_no_overlap_per_family
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dim_pipeline a JOIN dim_pipeline b ON a.family = b.family AND a.pipeline_key < b.pipeline_key AND a.valid_from <= b.valid_to AND b.valid_from <= a.valid_to

checks.name: scd2_one_current_per_family
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT family FROM dim_pipeline GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(is_current::INT) <> 1)

checks.name: pipeline_day_complete_4_per_day
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT date_key FROM fact_pipeline_day GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) <> 4)

checks.name: iri_unique_and_wellformed
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dim_taxon WHERE iri NOT LIKE 'http://example.org/knowledge-hub/biomed/C%'
